+def _component_06(data):
+    packages = data["packages"]
+    names = sorted(packages, reverse=True)
+    features = set(data.get("features", []))
+    blocked = data.get("blocked", {})
+    pins = data.get("pins", {})
+    constraints = {name: [tuple(bounds)] for name, bounds in data["roots"].items()}
+    best_vector = None
+    best = None
+
+    def cycle(assignments):
+        state = {}
+        def visit(name):
+            if state.get(name) == 1:
+                return True
+            if state.get(name) == 2:
+                return False
+            state[name] = 1
+            row = assignments[name]
+            for dep in row.get("deps", []):
+                feature = dep.get("feature", "")
+                if feature and feature not in features:
+                    continue
+                if visit(dep["name"]):
+                    return True
+            state[name] = 2
+            return False
+        return any(visit(name) for name in assignments if not state.get(name))
+
+    def search(assignments, limits):
+        nonlocal best_vector, best
+        for name, row in assignments.items():
+            for low, high in limits.get(name, []):
+                if not low <= row["version"] <= high:
+                    return
+        pending = [name for name in limits if name not in assignments]
+        if not pending:
+            if cycle(assignments):
+                return
+            vector = tuple(assignments[n]["version"] if n in assignments else -1 for n in names)
+            if best_vector is None or vector > best_vector:
+                best_vector = vector
+                best = {n: row["version"] for n, row in assignments.items()}
+            return
+
+        name = pending[0]
+        ranges = limits[name]
+        low = max(r[0] for r in ranges)
+        high = min(r[1] for r in ranges)
+        rows = [row for row in packages[name]
+                if low <= row["version"] <= high
+                and row["version"] not in blocked.get(name, [])
+                and (name not in pins or row["version"] == pins[name])]
+        for row in rows:
+            next_assignments = dict(assignments)
+            next_assignments[name] = row
+            next_limits = {n: list(rs) for n, rs in limits.items()}
+            valid = True
+            for dep in row.get("deps", []):
+                feature = dep.get("feature", "")
+                if feature and feature not in features:
+                    continue
+                dep_name = dep["name"]
+                interval = (dep["min"], dep["max"])
+                if dep_name in next_assignments:
+                    version = next_assignments[dep_name]["version"]
+                    if not interval[0] <= version <= interval[1]:
+                        valid = False
+                        break
+                next_limits.setdefault(dep_name, []).append(interval)
+            if valid:
+                search(next_assignments, next_limits)
+
+    search({}, constraints)
+    return {"error": "unsatisfiable"} if best is None else {"versions": best}

+def _component_07(data):
+    jobs = data["jobs"]

+    for mask in range(1 << n):

+            continue

+        ids = tuple(sorted(job["id"] for job in selected))

+            continue

+        events = sorted((job["start"], 1) for job in selected) + sorted((job["end"], -1) for job in selected)
